# SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers 2.6.1 (SQLite 3.54.0)

The database engine, compiled by `package:sqlite3`'s build hook — see the
`hooks:` section of `client/pubspec.yaml` for why it is vendored and how it is
configured (SQLCipher 4 format, so existing databases keep opening).

Unmodified files from
`sqlite3mc-2.6.1-sqlite-3.54.0-amalgamation.zip`
(<https://github.com/utelle/SQLite3MultipleCiphers/releases/tag/v2.6.1>),
SHA-256 of the zip
`3f25af603566a23c821d8e581778b5ece2a541d2435776de57b8d845c176815a`, as listed
in the release's `sqlite3mc-2.6.1-SHA256SUMS`. `shell3mc_amalgamation.c` (the
command-line shell) is left out.

Licence: MIT (`LICENSE`); SQLite itself is public domain.
